item.title: More to ‘Tell’: Jason Aldean Notches His Newest Multiweek Country Airplay No. 1
item.description:
[Upbeat music plays]
Host: "Welcome to the latest music update. We've got some exciting news from the world of country music. Jason Aldean is still reigning supreme on the Billboard Country Airplay chart with his song 'Don't Tell on Me'. For the second week in a row, it's sitting pretty at number one, with a 2% increase in audience impressions, reaching 31.6 million people."
[Short music transition]
Host: "This is a big deal for Aldean, as it's his 27th number one song and his first multi-week leader since 'Trouble with a Heartbreak' back in May 2022. And get this, it's his 13th career number one to stay at the top for two weeks or more. 'Don't Tell on Me' was written by Kurt Allison, Tully Kennedy, John Morgan, and Lydia Vaughan, and it's been a game-changer for Aldean's career."
[Short music transition]
Host: "With this achievement, Aldean has moved into fourth place for the most number one songs on the Country Airplay chart, surpassing Luke Bryan, Alan Jackson, and George Strait. He's now behind only Kenny Chesney, Blake Shelton, and Tim McGraw. And what's impressive is that Aldean has achieved this with fewer chart titles than the acts ahead of him."
[Short music transition]
Host: "In other news, Ella Langley is making waves on the chart with her new single 'Loving Life Again', which debuts at number 53. She's also seeing success with her collaboration with Morgan Wallen, 'I Can't Love You Anymore', which is climbing the chart. We'll be keeping an eye on these artists and more, so stay tuned for the latest updates."
[Closing music plays]
Host: "That's all for now. Check out the latest charts and updates on Billboard.com, and we'll catch you in the next episode."
